groups.name: maintained-source-pins
groups.rationale: Recorded cimgui and nested Dear ImGui revisions are provenance inputs; they do not add a safe Rust contract by themselves.

groups.name: version-constants
groups.rationale: Dear ImGui version macros remain part of the sys-level source contract; safe crates continue to report their Rust package version instead of aliasing C preprocessor state.

groups.name: stb-text-edit-internals
groups.rationale: These declarations expose Dear ImGui's embedded stb_textedit storage layout for raw ABI completeness. They are implementation bookkeeping, have no stable behavioral contract, and should not receive safe Rust wrappers.
